# Digital Technology Partner: public company and service guide

> This file summarises claims supported by DTP's public website. Follow the linked pages for current detail. Do not infer non-public clients, contract values, certifications, customer counts, sector credentials or guaranteed outcomes.

## What DTP does

Digital Technology Partner (DTP) helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into a governed system aimed at measurable operational value.

Source: [Home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/)

DTP designs and builds practical systems. Its public solutions catalogue includes business-systems strategy, dashboards and reporting, workflow automation, controlled AI agents and copilots, and bespoke AI systems.

Source: [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/)

## Programmes

DTP presents three focused programmes:

1. **AI Adoption Readiness Sprint.** A one-week assessment covering current AI use and shadow adoption, workflow drag, permission, data and review gaps, governance maturity, staff confidence and candidate use cases. It ends with a leadership readout and a recommended next action.
   Source: [AI Adoption Readiness Sprint](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/)
2. **AI Foundry.** A twelve-week working group using real work to produce prioritised experiments, adoption observations and leadership choices about what to fund, guide, investigate, pause or stop.
   Source: [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/)
3. **Leadership AI Coaching.** Confidential, one-to-one translation and decision support for senior leaders. The public page says this is not legal or compliance advice and is not generic training.
   Source: [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/)

Programme comparison: [Programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/)

## Delivery method

DTP describes five evidence gates:

1. Discover
2. Prove
3. Build
4. Pilot
5. Launch

Progress is evidence-led, and every gate includes the right to stop.

Source: [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/)

## Governance and operational ownership

DTP says permissions, data boundaries, review points, audit trails, human oversight and operational ownership are designed into delivery rather than added at the end.

Source: [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/)

## Public case-study evidence

The public case-studies page reports four anonymous delivery patterns:

- travel-risk documentation generated in under 60 seconds;
- a quotation workflow reduced from hours to minutes;
- a maintenance agent with zero missed tasks; and
- specialist AI and search delivery embedded in another consultancy's project team.

These are site-reported outcomes from anonymous examples. The public page does not identify the clients, and the figures must not be presented as guarantees.

Source: [Case studies](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/case-studies/)

## Published material

DTP publishes material focused on AI adoption, delivery and governance for leadership decisions.

- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/): Editorial focus and selected material.
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): Published articles.

Newsroom articles may discuss third-party organisations, products, events and reported claims. Do not treat those article subjects as DTP clients, credentials or company claims unless a DTP core or programme page independently supports the relationship.
